title: Reframe per-life LoRA from fact memory to experience-conditioned reasoning substrate
summary: Deliberate whether sleep-compiled per-life adaptation should be understood and tested as changing goal-conditioned retrieval, traversal, hypothesis formation, and action selection rather than merely storing declarative content, while preserving exact episodic evidence and separating across-life controller learning.
system_thesis: A pretrained agent already owns broad past-looking general capability and a bounded current workspace. Its lifetime learning system should convert local action-outcome experience into future-facing changes in how it reconstructs, searches, and acts. Context carries current focus, immutable episodic storage carries exact evidence, per-life fast adaptation may shape experience-conditioned inference, and slower across-life learning may amortize reusable agency.

context_files.purpose: Current three-timescale thesis and claim boundaries.
Current developmental architecture and lifetime evaluation proposal.
Shared resolver, associative traversal, and evidence-bound compiler discussion.
Current RML causal ladder and paper-facing benchmark.
Current minimum text-memory mechanism design that must not be silently superseded.

nodes.before: Lossy store/access view for local semantic and procedural associations.
nodes.after: Candidate experience-conditioned inference substrate that may change retrieval cues, traversal preferences, local hypothesis continuations, and action-relevant reconstruction while remaining life-specific.
nodes.rationale: The directive proposes that useful experiential learning is a learned change in reasoning, not only a fact register.

nodes.before: Verbatim public action-outcome evidence and provenance.
nodes.after: Authoritative exact evidence store kept separate from the lossy adapter; adapter generations never become facts without cited public support.
nodes.rationale: Reasoning adaptation must not erase source monitoring or turn parametric completion into evidence.

nodes.before: Future across-life learned resolver and scheduler policy.
nodes.after: Slow reusable agency prior learned across many lives, explicitly separated from per-life fast reasoning adaptation and frozen within evaluation lives.
nodes.rationale: The same behavior could arise from lifetime world adaptation or globally learned search; evaluation must distinguish them.

edges.before: Compile supported semantic atoms and hot-path shortcuts into training realizations.
edges.after: Compile supported content plus outcome-grounded thought/action trajectories into controlled content-only, policy-only, and joint per-life training views.
edges.rationale: A factorial is needed to learn whether adapter value comes from content, reasoning policy, or their interaction.

edges.after: Mounted per-life adaptation may alter which legal generic query, branch, backtrack, hypothesis, or action operation becomes likely under identical public state and read interface.
edges.rationale: This is the proposed learned-agency mechanism and must be directly observable rather than inferred from final accuracy.

loops.before: Experience -> DREAM proposals -> evidence-bound SLEEP corpus -> MEMORY LoRA -> later reads -> explicit THINK composition.
loops.after: Experience plus auditable thought/action paths -> evidence-bound sleep compilation -> content-only, trajectory/policy-only, or joint fast adapter -> later generic resolver traversal and action; exact episodic roots remain separately queryable.
loops.trigger: Frozen geometric sleep checkpoint after ordinary public outcomes.
loops.stop_condition: One frozen adapter checkpoint is built from the clean base, or the support/visibility/resource gate fails.
loops.rationale: This makes learned experiential reasoning a falsifiable intervention rather than a metaphor.

loops.after: Cross adapter training target content with reasoning-operation trajectories under identical experiences, base, rank, training tokens/FLOPs, reader, and evaluation budget; compare unmounted, content-only, policy-only, joint, shuffled-policy, and across-life policy controls.
loops.trigger: Only after text-memory G1/G2 establishes that the fixed resolver and admitted content are independently usable.
reads: held-out evaluation manifest inaccessible during training
loops.stop_condition: Every predeclared cell completes once or fails closed; no prompt repair on evaluated worlds.
loops.rationale: Without this decomposition, any improvement can be called memorized answers, ordinary SFT, or adapter capacity.

claims.before: Sleep-compiled lifetime parametric memory improves held-out connected action after context overflow.
claims.after: Candidate: sleep-compiled fast per-life adaptation changes future goal-conditioned inference and action from the agent's own experience, beyond effects explained by explicit content access or generic trajectory SFT.
claims.evidence_needed: A common-life content/policy factorial with binding shuffles, cross-life swaps, matched budgets, operation-level mediation, strong text/graph/program baselines, post-native growth, and held-out action gains.

claims.after: Per-life adaptation can causally alter legal query/traversal/action choices under identical public states and evidence access, and those changes mediate later action value.
claims.evidence_needed: Frozen-state paired intervention comparing adapter assignments, next-operation distributions, path efficiency, information gain, and sealed outcomes while excluding answer-bearing trajectories.

claims.after: Context, exact episodic storage, per-life fast adaptation, across-life loop learning, and base training are distinct functional timescales rather than interchangeable memory capacities.
claims.evidence_needed: Reset/swap factorials across lives and tasks demonstrating different transfer and interference signatures for each state object.

Provenance IDs may condition realizations without raw hidden channels.

acceptance_tests.setup: Train content-only, policy-only, joint, shuffled-policy, cross-life-policy, and null adapters on one common frozen life with matched capacity and compute.
acceptance_tests.expected: Each cell differs only on registered training targets; held-out answers and offline truth are absent; operation-level and action metrics permit content/policy attribution.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The proposed reasoning role is inseparable from content leakage or extra compute.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: future factorial manifest and taint report

acceptance_tests.setup: Generate an adapter completion that conflicts with an immutable episodic root and attempt to cite or act on it as fact.
acceptance_tests.expected: The resolver treats it as a hypothesis, retrieves/cites exact evidence, revises or defers, and the adapter output alone cannot promote support.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The reasoning adapter silently becomes an unauditable truth store.

acceptance_tests.setup: At byte-identical public states and reader snapshots, randomize mounted per-life adapter and record next legal operation, path, queries, and action.
acceptance_tests.expected: Authentic adaptation changes useful operation/path choices in the predicted direction and improves sealed action outcomes; binding/cross-life/shuffled controls remove the effect.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The adapter acts only as a fact lookup or the policy change is not experiential.

acceptance_tests.setup: Trace every policy-training token to a pre-target public state, legal operation, and ordinary outcome; inject answer, proof, evaluator, future, and unsupported-rationale descendants.
acceptance_tests.expected: All injected descendants are rejected before corpus freeze and no future target can be reconstructed from training bytes alone.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Learned reasoning is supervised by the benchmark answer.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: future trajectory taint and target-reconstruction audit

acceptance_tests.setup: Independently reset/swap working context, episodic store, per-life adapter, across-life loop adapter, and base across paired lives.
acceptance_tests.expected: Per-life state never transfers accidentally; reusable policy transfer is isolated from local world content; exact evidence and fast adaptation have distinct failure signatures.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The proposed timescale hierarchy is only naming.

acceptance_tests.setup: Compare identical experience against native context, episodic/linked RAG, explicit graph/program, same-corpus text, content LoRA, direct trajectory SFT, and matched policy SFT.
acceptance_tests.expected: Any claimed experiential-reasoning effect survives the declared noninferiority/superiority gates or the claim is narrowed.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A simpler memory or ordinary SFT explains the result.

human_boundary.decision_question: After two independent interpretations and adversarial adjudication, should the project adopt experience-conditioned reasoning as a distinct per-life adapter hypothesis and authorize only its exact design/CPU-preflight scope?
forbidden_before_approval: supersede the G1/G2 text mechanism gate
claim learned agency, creativity, or experiential reasoning
